profile.headline: Web DevOps at Cisco Security & Trust Organization
profile.summary: I studied biochemistry and engineering management in college then worked as an operations manager building scientific instruments  for 5 years before teaching myself to code.  Since becoming a software engineer in 2016, most of my experience has been on various devops projects, which I define as improving how a group of people works together to deliver a technical piece of work.  My favorite problem to solve is how people can effectively work together in a technical setting, but modern cloud services are pretty cool too.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a member of the Corona team, I have applied devops concepts to continuously improve the delivery and operations of an internal image scanning service.  In my time with the team, we have:

– Fulfilled demand increases from ~10 scans per day to ~1,000 scans per day
– Improved scan success rates from ~60% to >99%
– Achieved application and scanning uptime >99%
– Reduced scan times by improving both software and infrastructure
– Reduced deploy-time toil from dozens of engineer-hours to (at most) the click of a button
– Migrated all image scanning from on-prem to AWS infrastructure with zero downtime
– Improved our testing strategy and coverage to maintain service quality

Cloud Services:

– Worked with a Technical Leader to define and design a cloud-native image scanning service to migrate image scanning from on-prem to AWS infrastructure
– Championed and led the adoption of AWS CDK for the development and deployment of the image scanning service
– Owning the ongoing operations of this service once deployed, maintaining >99% job quality while continuing to simplify / improve the production environment
– Key services and tools:  AWS CDK (Cloud Development Kit, TypeScript IaC) / CloudFormation for all deployment via CodeSuite, API Gateway, Lambda (Python runtime), DynamoDB, Step Functions, Batch, EC2, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Docker, etc.

Internal / On-Prem Infrastructure:

– Extensive use of Terraform and Ansible to automate the provisioning and configuration of Corona’s internal Ruby on Rails app in an on-prem OpenStack environment
– Used Jenkins and Docker to fully automate the PR acceptance testing and production deployment validation & release processes (developers click a button to deploy)
– Developed several Dockerized microservices for the now-defunct Crate (Rancher) container environment
– Conceptualized and led an architectural evolution from shared storage to instance-based SSD storage to drastically improve scanning performance and reduce costs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
– Contributed to development of three Meteor applications for both customer and internal use cases
– Built a documented and tested state machine to replace loosely defined license management system
– Supported ERP system upgrade with work in Python and PostgreSQL
– Extensive use of Atlassian product suite (Bitbucket, Jira, Confluence)
– Primary technologies used include Meteor (Node.js platform), CoffeeScript (JavaScript), Bootstrap, Less, Underscore, jQuery, Chai (test library), MongoDB, Git, Ubuntu

positions.title: Director of Operations
positions.description:
Lead Division-wide efforts related to ongoing operational improvements:
– Conceptualized, built and maintained internal communication, project management, documentation and record keeping systems
– Automated workflows such as incoming inspections, sales order reviews, device calibrations and checkout, and quality record keeping
– Wrote Python scripts to automate some standard financial reporting processes
– Worked with engineering team to further develop and standardize engineering, product development, and production management processes
– Planned new production workflow during Systems Division move to new facility

Lead team of 5 technicians to balance R&D and production commitments:
– Directed implementation of management system that is optimized for primarily project-based work, minimizing the need for central control to maximize flexibility and responsiveness
– Team handled jobs ranging from R&D projects to production runs of 100+ devices

Directed all purchasing activities of the Systems Division:
– Developed controlled process to allow non-technical employees to reliably order custom components from approved suppliers
– Developed standardized methods for identification of slow-moving inventory to provide feedback for improved purchasing decisions

positions.title: Operations Planner
positions.description:
– Managed initial setup and ongoing improvement of inventory management and related accounting systems, including the completion of year-end inventory audits
– Identified and built relationships with key suppliers for PCBAs, as well as optical and mechanical components
– Processed all sales orders, purchase orders, shipments and customs processing for the Systems Division
– Worked with State Department to clarify the commodity jurisdiction of a potentially ITAR-controlled device

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: The Chordoma Foundation is a non-profit organization dedicated to the rapid advancement of research leading to the development of improved treatments and ultimately a cure for a rare form of cancer.  Utilized knowledge of biochemistry to assist in the collection of drug data for a database to be used as a reference to identify potential candidates for chordoma research.

positions.title: Clinical Data Management Intern
positions.description: Leveraged knowledge of biochemistry and newfound interest in management to conceptualize, design and implement an automated data analysis program using Microsoft Excel VBA.  One lab technician could apply the program to 8-10 present and future projects, reducing the weekly time commitment for data analysis from 10+ hours to 30 minutes or less.  Also responsible for the organization and construction of an SPSS database containing questionnaire responses and quantitative lab data for clinical trial subjects.

company.name: Emory University Alcohol and Lung Biology Center

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Organized digital library of construction, architectural, and engineering drawings using the company server, thereby enabling employees to rapidly access archived files.
